Object Registration Assign Sts_MtdID even if Registry Array size is insufficient ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- The Object Register instruction can be used within AOI's, Routines, and Programs and is designed to acquire the instantiated location and create a unique ID based on the Parent ID supplied. The name, location and ID are then copied into a registry queue.
Instruction Execution: ----- Edge
Supplemental Descriptions: -----
Sts_ERR Enumeration: Value Error Description
0 No errors present 1010 Registration Failed. Object Registry Array is full. 1011 Registration Failed. Object Registry Array Pointer value is invalid 1012 Registration Failed. Parent ID is Zero 1013 Registration Failed. Destination String Length is Shorter than Object Type Data
Sts_EXERR Enumeration: If an instruction error occurs internally, the value of the instruction*.ERR DINT will be placed in Sts_EXERR.
Revision Notes: ----- 2.2.00 - Assign Sts_MtdID even if Registry Array size is insufficient 2.1.00 - Pointer overflow fixed 2.0.00 - Added Inf_Lib. Replaced TND with JMP. Initialize on First Scan. 1.0.00 - Release
